'''Death''' occurs when a [[Account|player's]] [[Hitpoints]] reach zero; a message in the [[Chat Interface]] will inform them: {{mes|Oh dear, you are dead!}}. Death can also occur when alternative criteria are met, such as being completely frozen at the [[Wintertodt]] which causes the player's death despite not losing any Hitpoints. After death, the player will [[respawn]] at another location potentially deal with further consequences, such as [[Items Kept on Death|losing or breaking some items]].
